summary: מָרַד describes subjects withdrawing allegiance from a ruler. In Genesis 14:4 the kings rebel in the thirteenth year after serving Chedorlaomer for twelve years.

senses.definition: To reject the authority of a ruler to whom one has been subject.

evidence.note: עָבְדוּ names the kings’ twelve years of service to Chedorlaomer. מָרָדוּ describes their break with him in the thirteenth year.
